0022600115.text: The Timberwolves, 2-0 and on a two-game winning streak, host the Toronto Raptors, also 2-0 and on a two-game streak, in Minnesota's third game of the 2026-27 season. Minnesota sits 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West, while Toronto is 2nd in the Atlantic, half a game back, and 4th in the East. Donte DiVincenzo is out for Minnesota with an Achilles injury following surgery, and Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (heel, after surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet this season, but Minnesota won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 115-107 in Minneapolis on March 5, 2026.
